name: ERP 计费规则与费用团队
description: 计费规则与费用明细团队：巡检岗只读盘点规则版本状态与费用明细（含四层溯源），核对岗重算费用、试算新旧规则差异并对差异出提案、把规则修订落成草稿，拍板岗审批规则上线并对错计费用红冲；三岗错峰 06:30/06:37/06:44。装包后需手动启动，首回合只读巡检、不出结论。边界：费率必须有出处、计费落账只走机器车道提案不绕过确认门、升版不重写历史费用；资金执行（资金池/代收代付/分账）一律拒绝（二清红线）。
notes: 舰队模板 pack：装包后需手动启动（从模板实例化建队，新队默认暂停），首回合只读巡检、不出结论。三岗错峰 06:30 / 06:37 / 06:44；成员 target 解析到 erp-billing-fleet-roles 的三名岗位 preset；确认门只属拍板岗，逐岗工具面经 resources.mcpTools 收窄。persona 禁含花括号字面量与内部路径；fleetContext 只入 cadence.promptTemplate。状态：publish-ready 源清单，未上架（packId 未铸造）——待 roles 包先上架取得 packId 后回填依赖再铸。

en.name: ERP Billing & Fee Team
en.description: Billing rule and fee-detail team: the inspector reads rule version states and fee detail (with four-layer provenance), the reconciler recomputes fees, simulates old-vs-new rule deltas, files proposals for each difference and lands rule revisions as drafts, and the decider approves rule go-live and reverses mis-billed fees; posts stagger at 06:30 / 06:37 / 06:44. Install, then start manually; the first round is read-only inspection and reaches no conclusion. Boundaries: every rate must carry a source, billing reaches the ledger only through the machine-lane proposal (never around the confirmation gate), a version bump never rewrites historical fees; fund execution is refused outright (second-clearing red line).
en.notes: Fleet template pack: install, then start manually (instantiated from the template, a new fleet is born paused); the first round is read-only inspection and reaches no conclusion. Posts stagger at 06:30 / 06:37 / 06:44; member targets resolve to the three post presets of erp-billing-fleet-roles; the confirmation gate belongs to the decider only, and per-post tool faces are narrowed via resources.mcpTools. Personas carry no literal braces or internal paths; fleetContext appears only in cadence.promptTemplate. Status: publish-ready source, not yet listed (packId not minted) — mint the roles pack first, then backfill the dependency.
